title: NASA opens applications for early career exoplanet research presentations
excerpt: Early career scientists may apply to present research at the ExoPAG 35 meeting.
bodyHtml:
NASA's Exoplanet Program Analysis Group's Executive Committee and the Exoplanet Exploration Program Office announced on October 16, 2026, that applications are open for early career researchers to give presentations at the ExoPAG 35 meeting.

The ExoPAG EC and ExEP are inviting up to 50 early career researchers to give 1-2 minute pop presentations. There will be up to 25 presentations each day on January 9th and 10th. Participants will share work with a broad audience of scientists, technologists, and program managers.

Eligible participants include undergraduate students, post-bachelor researchers, graduate students, and post-doctoral scientists. The ExoPAG EC invites researchers to share work on topics including how planets form, how they evolve, or how to search for and characterize them. Presentations are also encouraged to align with the priorities described in the current Exoplanet Exploration Program Science Gap List.

Applications are due November 6, 2026 by 6pm PST. Applicants will be notified by November 13, 2026.
